_comment: Feats (Player's Handbook 2024, chapter 5). category: origin (from a background, or a human's Versatile), general, fighting_style, epic. trait: the data/traits.json definition that does what it does in a fight (kernel hooks and modifiers). choices: picked when the feat is taken (rules/feats.py; a background may fix some, as Magic Initiate (Cleric) fixes the list): kind skill, skill_or_tool, tool (from a group in rules/feats.py TOOL_GROUPS), spell_list, cantrip, spell (level), ability. upgrade_in: the expansion that brings the rest of it.

alert.name: Alert
alert.text: Always ready: your proficiency bonus is added to your initiative.

crafter.name: Crafter
crafter.text: Proficiency with three kinds of artisan's tools, and a fifth off the price of anything plain you buy in a shop.

healer.name: Healer
healer.text: Battle Medic: with a healer's kit and an action, a friend beside you spends a Hit Die and heals it and your proficiency bonus. Healing dice that come up 1 are rolled again.

lucky.name: Lucky
lucky.text: Luck points equal to your proficiency bonus, back after a long rest: a missed attack or a failed saving throw is rolled again (the better kept).

magic_initiate.name: Magic Initiate
magic_initiate.text: Two cantrips and one level 1 spell of the cleric's, the druid's or the wizard's lists; the spell is cast once a long rest without a slot.

musician.name: Musician
musician.text: Proficiency with three musical instruments; after a rest, a song gives Heroic Inspiration to as many companions as your proficiency bonus.

savage_attacker.name: Savage Attacker
savage_attacker.text: Once a turn, when you hit with a weapon, its damage dice are rolled twice and the higher kept.

skilled.name: Skilled
skilled.text: Proficiency in three skills or tools of your choice.

tavern_brawler.name: Tavern Brawler
tavern_brawler.text: Your fists hit for 1d4 + Strength, and a 1 on their damage is rolled again; you are proficient with improvised weapons; once a turn a punch can shove the one you hit 5 feet away.

tough.name: Tough
tough.text: Two more hit points at every level.
